question:
Match the following Indexes with their respective Publishing Organizations:

 
 

 
 
**Column A - Index**

 
 
 
**Column B-Publishing Organization**

 
 
 

 
 
A.

 
 Global Innovation Index
 
 
1.

 
 United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)
 
 

 
 
B.

 
 Global Hunger Index
 
 
2.

 
 World intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)
 
 

 
 
C.

 
 Global Peace Index
 
 
3.

 
 Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe
 
 

 
 
D.

 
 Human Development Index (HDI)
 
 
4.

 
 Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4: A - 2, B - 3, C - 4, D - 1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Global Innovation Index** is published by the **World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO)**, which measures innovation capabilities and performance across the globe.
 
• **Global Hunger Index** is released jointly by **Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe**, focusing on hunger and undernutrition globally.
 
• **Global Peace Index** is published by the **Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)**, assessing peace levels in countries based on various indicators.
 
• **Human Development Index (HDI)** is released by the **United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)**, measuring human development through education, income, and life expectancy indicators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Global Innovation Index (GII):**

 
 
• The GII ranks countries annually on innovation performance based on institutions, human capital, technology, and creative outputs.
 
• It is a collaboration between WIPO, Cornell University, and INSEAD.
 
 
 
• **Global Hunger Index (GHI):**
 
 
• The GHI uses indicators such as undernourishment, child wasting, child stunting, and child mortality to rank countries.
 
• Its goal is to track hunger reduction progress globally and highlight areas needing improvement.
 
 
 
• **Global Peace Index (GPI):**
 
 
• The GPI evaluates nations based on societal safety, levels of violence, and military expenditure.
 
• It is widely regarded as a benchmark for assessing global peace trends.
 
 
 
• **Human Development Index (HDI):**
 
 
• The HDI measures long-term progress in three dimensions: a long and healthy life, access to knowledge, and a decent standard of living.
 
• It categorizes countries into four tiers of human development: low, medium, high, and very high.
